name: saqi
description: Arabic poetry corpus, public Astro site, and Cloudflare ingestion workers

scripts.build: yarn build:api && yarn workspace @saqi/crawler-local build && yarn workspace @saqi/site build && yarn workspace @saqi/app build
scripts.build:api: yarn workspace @saqi/source-adapter build && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso build && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-node build
scripts.fix: yarn workspace @saqi/source-adapter fix && yarn workspace @saqi/crawler-local fix && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso fix && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-node fix && yarn workspace @saqi/app fix
scripts.check:built: yarn workspace @saqi/source-adapter check && yarn workspace @saqi/crawler-local check && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso check && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-node check && yarn workspace @saqi/app check && yarn workspace @saqi/site check
scripts.test: yarn build:api && yarn workspace @saqi/source-adapter test && yarn workspace @saqi/crawler-local test && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso test && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-node test && yarn workspace @saqi/app test && yarn workspace @saqi/site test
scripts.test:built: yarn workspace @saqi/source-adapter test && yarn workspace @saqi/crawler-local test && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso test && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-node test && yarn workspace @saqi/app test && yarn workspace @saqi/site test
scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -Avp run clean && yarn clean::deps
